title: AFTER HOURS - Part 1
notes: Qwen3-TTS, no new voices: narrator = VIDEO_008; mia = VIDEO_009 'her'; teacher = VIDEO_009 'intercom' (fx intercom).

narrator.ref_text: It was late, and the street outside was quiet. Somewhere a door closed, and I waited.

mia.ref_text: Okay, your handwriting is honestly the worst I've ever seen. No, I'm kidding. Kind of. Hand me the glue?

teacher.ref_text: Good afternoon, students. This is your principal speaking. Please listen carefully to the following announcement.

lines.text: You and your friends sneak into school at midnight to change your exam answers. But somebody is already inside... grading them.
Rewind. The night before the exam, all five of you are online, gaming until four AM.
"One more game! The exam is easy anyway."
The exam is not easy. All five of you fail.
So Kai makes a plan. The answer sheets are locked in Room 12. Tonight, you fix them.
Midnight. One gym window is unlocked. The hallway is pitch black.
Room 12. The papers are on the desk. But they're already graded. And every single one says the same thing.
"Attendance. Five students present. Please... take your seats."
The door slams shut. Mia counts heads. One. Two. Three. Four.
On the board, chalk starts writing by itself. Kai. Detention. Four left.
Comment A or B. The top comment decides what happens in Part 2.
